# A call of a function the template set does not define stops muxt
# generate and muxt check with html/template's parse error, before any
# code is written. Builtins and functions registered with Funcs are
# defined; html/template's internal escapers are not.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmp stderr want-generate.txt
! exists template_routes.go

! muxt check
cmp stderr want-check.txt

cp good-template.gohtml template.gohtml
muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check
stdout 'ok: 1 template'

cp escaper-template.gohtml template.gohtml
! muxt check
stderr 'function "_html_template_htmlescaper" not defined'

-- want-generate.txt --
Error: template: template.gohtml:3: function "foo" not defined
-- want-check.txt --
Error: fail: template: template.gohtml:3: function "foo" not defined
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>{{shout .Result}}</p>
<p title="{{.Result | foo}}">x</p>
{{end}}
-- good-template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>{{shout .Result}} {{len .Result}} {{printf "%s" .Result | html}} {{urlquery .Result}}</p>
{{end}}
-- escaper-template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>{{_html_template_htmlescaper .Result}}</p>
{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"strings"
)

//go:embed template.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.New("").Funcs(template.FuncMap{
	"shout": strings.ToUpper,
}).ParseFS(source, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() string { return "index" }
